responsibility: Defines the common WebAssembly TargetOptions baseline, including wasm-ld linking arguments, artifact naming, dynamic-linking model, self-contained linking, panic and relocation defaults, TLS behavior, and other wasm-wide codegen constraints.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/call/wasm.rs` and `asm/wasm.rs`, this WebAssembly file provides the reusable `TargetOptions` baseline—LLD arguments, artifact naming, self-contained linking, panic/relocation/TLS defaults, and wasm-wide constraints—for concrete wasm targets.
